title: Six free references for your next agent review.
heading: Six free agent-security references for your next design review
intro: New specs and references from OWASP, CoSAI, MITRE ATLAS, and the MCP project, each mapped to a question you can ask in a review.
items: OWASP GenAI Red Teaming Manual v1.0 (Oct 20)
An eight-phase method, from planning to remediation, that covers agents.
CoSAI: Zero Trust for AI Systems (Sep 16)
Authorization can't be delegated to the model; bind sessions to the user and issue short-lived, scoped tokens.
New agent techniques, such as probing trigger channels and discovering runtime capabilities.
Runtime hooks and portable policy across agent frameworks. Early stage (v0.1).
Four assurance levels across eight security dimensions.
Removes protocol-level sessions; clients must validate the issuer in authorization responses when present.
